Software Engineering Manager, People with Disabilities

This role is part of Google's initiative to engage the People with Disabilities community. All candidates with disabilities will be evaluated in accordance with Article 93 of Federal Labor Law 8.213/91. Please include documentation of your disability in your application.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role overseeing strategic projects, including 2 years in team supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields.
  • Experience designing and implementing large-scale distributed systems.

About the Job

As a Software Engineering Manager at Google, you will lead technical projects and manage engineering teams across multiple locations. Your role involves guiding project goals, contributing to product strategy, and mentoring your team. You will work on diverse areas such as information retrieval, AI, natural language processing, distributed computing, and more.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of software engineers, fostering an inclusive and safe environment.
  • Lead planning, execution, and delivery of projects.
  • Define team vision and strategy.
  • Support career development and coaching of team members.

Google values diversity and is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and require proficiency in English for collaboration purposes.

Investment Manager – Renewable Energy & Infrastructure

Location: Brazil
Sector: Solar PV & Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)
Client: Leading Chinese Infrastructure Owner/Operator
Salary: Competitive
Recruitment Partner: TGRC
Consultant: Amy Wu –

About the Company

Our client is a prominent Chinese infrastructure investor and operator with a growing international portfolio focused on renewable energy and energy transition assets. With strategic interests across Latin America, the firm is committed to delivering sustainable, utility-scale energy projects across key markets.

To support its expanding operations in Brazil, the firm is seeking an experienced Investment Manager to lead commercial and financial oversight across solar PV and BESS investments in the region.

Role Overview

As the Investment Manager, you will play a key role in evaluating, executing, and managing infrastructure investments across renewable energy assets in Brazil. You will be responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of investment projects, including commercial due diligence, project financing, budgeting, and performance monitoring. Your deep understanding of solar PV and battery storage technologies, alongside strong financial acumen, will be critical to ensuring investment success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the end-to-end investment process for renewable energy infrastructure projects, with a focus on solar PV and BESS

  • Conduct commercial and financial due diligence, including modelling, risk analysis, and investment structuring

  • Oversee cost management throughout the investment lifecycle, ensuring adherence to budget and profitability targets

  • Collaborate with technical, legal, and operations teams during investment execution and project delivery

  • Lead stakeholder engagement with local partners, regulatory bodies, and internal investment committees

  • Monitor asset performance and financial KPIs post-investment, providing regular reporting to senior leadership

  • Support corporate strategy development and market intelligence initiatives within the Latin American renewables market

Candidate Requirements

  • Proven track record of managing infrastructure or renewable energy investments, ideally within a global or cross-border context

  • In-depth knowledge of solar PV and BESS technologies and related commercial models

  • Strong background in cost management, budgeting, and financial analysis

  • Previous experience working within or alongside Chinese infrastructure or energy investors is an advantage

  • Fluent in English; Portuguese and/or Mandarin proficiency is desirable

  • Based in Brazil or willing to relocate

Why Apply?

This is a unique opportunity to join a globally recognised investor with long-term ambitions in Latin America. The successful candidate will play a strategic role in shaping the direction of clean energy infrastructure in one of the world’s most dynamic renewable markets.

Apply Now

TGRC is proud to be the exclusive recruitment partner for this opportunity. For a confidential discussion or to apply, please contact:

Amy Wu
Principal Consultant – Renewable Energy Investment

Confeccionar e retirar aparelhos gessados e enfaixamentos com o uso do material convencional e sintético.

Executar imobilizações com uso de esparadrapo e talas digitais e outros recursos disponíveis de acordo com a comorbidade do paciente.

Efetuar o preparo e administração de medicação (via oral, endovenosa, intravenosa, intramuscular, subcutânea ou via retal).

Prestar assistência acompanhando procedimentos médicos.

Realizar curativos em pacientes com a técnica e material adequado à ferida.

Encaminhar pacientes para exames de imagens, laboratório e internação, conforme solicitação prescrita ou orientada.

Solicitar e fazer a troca de materiais quebrados ou danificados, tão logo observe a necessidade.

Organizar e efetuar a higienização de materiais do setor e limpeza do expurgo do setor.

Arrumar e trocar as camas, macas do repouso e consultórios, mantendo o setor organizado e higienizado.

Conferir carrinho de emergência semanalmente e teste do cardioversor diariamente.

Promover ambiente de acolhimento aos acompanhantes e familiares.

Executar outras atividades correlatas, de acordo com as atribuições próprias de sua unidade operacional e da natureza do seu trabalho, conforme determinação superior.

title: Talent Acquisition Lead (Brazil, Peru or Ireland)
description:
Talent Acquisition Lead (Brazil, Peru or Ireland)

About DA

Delivery Associates (DA) is a global consultancy helping the public sector deliver lasting impact through effective implementation. With roots in Deliverology and over a decade of experience, we support leaders from strategy to execution. Our remote team works worldwide with governments and philanthropies to scale results.

We’re committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion—believing empowered, diverse teams drive stronger partnerships and more equitable outcomes.

Description

We are seeking a hands-on and proactive Talent Acquisition Lead to join our People team. This role is ideal for someone with some managerial experience, capable of leading a small team while delivering on core responsibilities within the Talent Acquisition function. The successful candidate is highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing their own workload alongside supporting the development and performance of others. They will serve as a Performance Manager to a small number of colleagues and play a key role in driving team collaboration and delivery.

While this is not a senior leadership role, we are looking for someone who has previously managed people and can confidently provide guidance, feedback, and support in a team setting. This role is fully remote, but the candidate should be based in Brazil, Peru or Ireland.

Key Responsibilities

People Leadership and team support:

  • Coach and mentor team members, providing constructive feedback to enhance their skills and capabilities.
  • Set clear objectives for team members, regularly reviewing progress and performance metrics to drive professional growth.
  • Represent the TA team as part of the wider People Team.
  • Act as a bridge between the TA team and senior leadership, facilitating effective communication and collaboration.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, high-performing, and accountable team culture.

Requisition Ownership:

  • Manage a portfolio of open roles across multiple functions and regions.
  • Lead end-to-end recruitment, including job briefings, sourcing, candidate assessment, and offer processes.
  • Partner with hiring managers to advise on recruitment strategy, structured interviews, and role scoping.
  • Ensure a high-quality candidate and hiring manager experience throughout.

Communication, Partnering and Stakeholder Management:

  • Collaborate with hiring managers and senior stakeholders to align on hiring needs and recruitment plans.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, offering clear guidance, timely updates, and pragmatic solutions.

Operational Input and process Improvements:

  • Identify operational challenges and areas for process improvement across the recruitment function.
  • Contribute to discussions and proposals to improve team efficiency and candidate experience.
  • Use data to monitor requisition progress, flag risks, and support quarterly reporting.
  • Comfortably handle reporting and data interpretation, using metrics to make informed decisions and drive improvements
  • Maintain accurate records in the applicant tracking system (Greenhouse) and support data-led decision-making.

Core Competencies

We work well with people who demonstrate the following competencies:

  • Execution – Manages requisitions from start to finish with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Communication & Partnering – Builds effective relationships with stakeholders and communicates clearly and professionally.
  • Responsibility & Autonomy – Works independently, takes ownership of tasks, and uses sound judgment to escalate when needed.
  • Team Contribution – Collaborates effectively, shares knowledge, and supports the success of the broader team.
  • People Development – Provides constructive feedback, supports the growth of direct reports, and contributes to a positive performance culture.

Mindsets

We work closely in diverse, global teams, leaning on each other’s strengths. We don’t expect any one person to do all these things perfectly. Our teams are made up of people who are:

  • Adaptable : Able to thrive in a dynamic environment.
  • Proactive: Anticipates needs, takes initiative without waiting for direction, and demonstrates a forward-thinking approach to tasks and challenges.
  • Initiative: Demonstrates a self-starting attitude, actively seeks opportunities to contribute, and pursues improvements without being prompted.
  • Resourceful: Effectively navigates constraints and finds practical solutions to deliver results, even in the absence of ideal conditions.
  • Detail-Oriented: Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness in all tasks, ensuring clarity, consistency, and high standards of quality.
  • Team-Oriented: Works collaboratively with colleagues, sharing knowledge and contributing to a supportive and effective team environment.
  • Accountable: Takes ownership of responsibilities, follows through on commitments, and consistently delivers reliable outcomes.
  • Inclusive : Embrace all voices and backgrounds to enrich our work.

Required Skills/Experiences:

  • A minimum of 6 years experience as a recruiter for an internal team, ideally in a high volume environment
  • Proven experience in people leadership, coaching, and providing feedback as a team lead or senior individual contributor
  • A proactive, resourceful and agile mindset is essential for this role
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively
  • Proficiency in data interpretation and reporting
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for partnering with senior leadership
  • Comfortable setting objectives, reviewing progress, and enhancing team performance
  • Previous experience hiring for top-tier consulting firms is desirable but not essential
  • Experience using Greenhouse, Slack and Google Suite
  • Fluent written and spoken English

What we offer:

  • Impactful work : Opportunities to engage with senior leaders and work on transformative projects.
  • Excellent colleagues: We strive to be as talent-dense and diverse as possible, so we are always learning from each other.
  • Growth environment : Everyone’s career pathway is unique-be part of a growing organization committed to continuous improvement.
  • Flexibility : Remote working environment with opportunities for global collaboration.
  • Healthy compensation : Our colleagues enjoy a comprehensive benefits package for the effort they put in.
  • Travel opportunities : Travel may be required depending on project needs.

Our Values:

These values serve as an anchor, enabling us to stay true to who we are and what we stand for.

  • Passion : It is all about impact.
  • Excellence : Delivering to the highest standards.

  • Position requires 24x7 operational leadership oversight with some after-hours work via remote access and mobile phone.

Description

Apply now for a career that puts wellbeing first!

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to our Integrations team, part of CODE Focus Area, in Brazil !

CODE leads the consumer digital experience providing user-focused excellent experiences enabling business scale and sustainable growth. CODE (Consumer Digital Experience) is responsible for evolving our product towards providing a simple, engaging and delightful experience to attract and retain more subscribers, helping them start and cultivate their wellbeing journey with Wellhub.

YOUR IMPACT

As a Senior Product Manager of Integrations, you'll play a crucial role in developing and implementing strategies to seamlessly integrate the Wellhub marketplace with different types of third parties such as Content Management Systems (CMS), Partner Apps and Wearables devices. Offering a frictionless experience to our user regardless of the type of partner they are interested in.

  • Lead the product integration roadmap ensuring that we are prioritizing the most impactful initiatives and we are aligned with Wellhub goals;
  • Conduct in-depth market research understanding the industry trends and best practices identifying integration opportunities and potential new partnerships;
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams such as engineering, data, sales, marketing to ensure that all of us are moving towards the same goals;
  • Monitor and analyze key performance metrics to optimize integration features and address the main necessities for our company and users;
  • Maintain and evolve our developers portal providing all the relevant information about how to integrate with us;
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • 2-4 years experience in leading system integrations;
  • English is a must. The majority of your stakeholders are native speakers;
  • Hands-on mindset, entrepreneurial and self-driven spirit with a great desire to make things happen;
  • Analytical and quantitative skills are a must, ability to use data and metrics to generate insights, iterate and improve the product;
  • Strong problem solving - be able to structure problems, prioritize and make pragmatic decisions in unstructured environments;
  • Capacity to identify and connect users needs and business needs, and develop effective ideas to meet them;
  • Seen as a plus:
    • Experience with CMS (club management systems) integrations;
    • Experience with Apps integrations;
    • Familiar with the most important integration standards (Restful APIs, Webhooks, Polling, RPC);
    • A true team player who loves working towards both team and individual goals with at least 0-3 years experience in business development, sales, corporate relationship management, or account management.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in leading system integrations, advanced to fluent English and analytical and quantitative skills are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: Choose when and where you work. For most, this will be a hybrid office/remote structure but can vary depending on the needs of the role and employee preferences. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge.

Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day.

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

title: Vice President of Research
description:
Why the American University of Iraq—Baghdad?
Opening its doors in January 2021, the new American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB) began as a dream of influential individuals in Iraqi and United States business, industry and government who want to see a world-class institution of higher learning established in the city, reminiscent of the days when Baghdad was an educational mecca and flourishing capital of the Muslim world. With a great library, palatial college buildings and student centers, state-of-the-art classrooms, laboratories, and athletic facilities, AUIB will be a beautiful campus, attracting students, faculty, and staff from throughout the world. We invite you to join us in this exciting new venture.

This position will report directly to the University President

Job Title: Vice President of Research

Department: Office of Research

Job Summary: The Vice President of Research plays a critical leadership role in advancing the research agenda of AUIB. This position is responsible for providing strategic direction, oversight, and coordination of all research activities within the university. The Vice President of Research works closely with faculty, staff, and external partners to promote a culture of research excellence and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership:

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive research strategy aligned with the university’s mission and goals.
  • Identify emerging research trends and opportunities and guide the university’s research priorities accordingly.
  • Foster a culture of research excellence, integrity, and collaboration across all academic departments and disciplines.

Administration:

  • Oversee the Research Office and all university research operations.
  • Develop university research themes and foster new research initiatives.
  • Delegate regulatory responsibility to appropriate university units.
  • Oversee all research centers, institutes, and appropriate shared or core research facilities.
  • Oversee research partnerships with industry, government, and partner institutions.
  • Represent the university at appropriate research initiatives/collaborations and programs.
  • Represent the university on the appropriate national and international research committees.
  • Communicate and report on the state of the research enterprise.
  • Develop and ensure the maintenance of policies and procedures and fiscal responsibilities for the Research Office and all pre- and post-grant award activities.
  • Ensure university membership in the appropriate professional research associations.
  • Oversee the outstanding faculty and student research awards.

Research Funding And Grants:

  • Identify and pursue external funding opportunities, grants, and partnerships to support research activities.
  • Provide guidance and support to faculty in the preparation and submission of research grant proposals.
  • Oversee the administration of research grants, ensuring compliance with funding agency requirements.

Research Conduct:

Human Research Participants:

  • Ensure the University’s human research participant protection program.
  • Ensure stakeholders and affiliates have adequate resources and appropriate oversight.
  • Receive and assess reports of non-compliance.
  • Place limitations or conditions on an investigator’s or research staff’s privilege to conduct human research.
  • Ensure that University officials cannot approve human research not by one of the Institution’s IRBs.
  • Disallow research approved by the Institution’s IRB or an external IRB.
  • Execute the education and training of personnel in support of an ethical human research participants program.

Animal Subjects:

  • Execute a humane and ethical animal welfare program in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, policies and procedures.
  • Communicate non-compliance to appropriate regulatory bodies.
  • Execute the education and training of personnel in support of humane animal care and use.
  • Establish a university animal care and use committee.

Research Safety and Integrity:

  • Support compliance of all government environmental, health, and safety regulations.

title: Partner Sales Director - Global System Integrator (GSI)
description:
Join to apply for the Partner Sales Director - Global System Integrator (GSI) role at Canonical

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Partner Sales Director - Global System Integrator (GSI) role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Global System Integrators (GSI) play a crucial role in Canonical growth plans in the coming 3 years. We are hiring a Partner Sales Director to work closely with Canonical GSI partners throughout their sales cycles and across their sales organizations to facilitate ubuntu based solutions and opportunities, as well as help GSI build long term digital transformation platforms with ubuntu stacks and services.
Reporting to the VP Global Alliances and Channels, the Partner Sales Director will be responsible for building trusted relationships with partners, increasing Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelizing about the partnership and leading all business interactions from engineers to CxO level. They will own the strategy, the sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions with the GSI and will animate many customer workshops, sales events, public presentations and executive engagements.
The role entails

  • Build strategic relationships with partners at levels, and stickiness with Ubuntu technology
  • Deep understanding of Linux and cloud software ecosystem, and open source selling models
  • Negotiate contracts and commercial business terms
  • Deep understanding of partner organizations and sales models, in particular with Global System Integrators
  • Work closely with marketing, sales engineering and product management to deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner
  • Lead executive interlocks between partners and Canonical leadership team
  • Ability to travel - sometimes internationally - up to 40% of the time
What we are looking for in you
  • Extensive experience in alliance or indirect sales management roles
  • Extensive experience with OpenStack, virtualization, containers and other Cloud technologies.
  • Autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality
  • Ability to capture customer requirements, evaluate gaps, identify and create opportunities
  • Passionate about Ubuntu products and mission
  • Comfortable in fast-paced and high pressure environments with ambitious achievement goals
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Begeleider Crisis Opvang Jeugdzorg
description:
Ondersteun je graag jongeren in hun meest kwetsbare situatie? En sta jij stevig in je schoenen? Kom werken bij Timon. Bekijk de vacature begeleider op onze crisisopvang in Zeist.

Op onze crisisopvang werk je in een kleinschalig-wonen-voorziening (24-uurs). Hier begeleiden we jongens en meiden vanaf 12 jaar. Je werkt aan de hand van een 24-uurs rooster. Je werkt dus ook ’s avonds, ’s nachts en in weekenden. We proberen jongeren succesvol over te plaatsen na circa 4 weken. Soms duurt het langer voordat we een geschikte vervolgplek vinden. Bekijk de video van onze crisisopvang hier .

Sociaal, stabiel en flexibel
Om allerlei redenen kan het spaaklopen in de thuissituatie. Zoals persoonlijkheidsproblematiek, een hechtingsstoornis of een systeemproblematiek. Dat kan zich op allerlei manieren uiten, bijvoorbeeld agressie, misbruik of middelengebruik. Lukt het thuis écht niet meer waardoor een jongere direct uit huis moet? Dan is de crisisopvang een plek waar je terechtkunt. Hier begeleiden we jongens en meiden vanaf 12 jaar. Als jeugdzorgwerker bied je een gestructureerd leefklimaat en begeleid je hen naar een vervolgplek. Dat vraagt van jou dat je sociaal bent, stevig in je schoenen staat én flexibel bent. Je hebt humor en een eindeloos enthousiasme voor jongeren, ook als ze langer in de crisisopvang blijven. Je kunt snel schakelen en blijft rustig onder alle omstandigheden.

Jouw werk doet ertoe
De jongeren hebben allemaal hun eigen kamer, maar ze doen veel samen. Zoals koken en eten, spelletjes en uitjes. Als jeugdzorgwerker bij de crisisopvang Zeist ben je daarom mentor én groepswerker. Je legt makkelijk contact en wint snel het vertrouwen. Je bént er voor de jongeren. Je helpt hen bij wat ze lastig vinden en ondersteunt bij hun taken en doelen. Je voelt spanningen aan en bij lastige situaties treed je de-escalerend op. Je regelt alles rond de crisisplaatsing en de vervolgplek. Stapje voor stapje help je de jongere verder. Kortom, jouw werk doet ertoe!

Dit ga je doen

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de begeleiding van de jongeren;
  • Je werkt 1-op-1 met jongeren én je bent beschikbaar op de groep;
  • Veel vrijheid om je begeleiding vorm te geven, passend bij wat op dat moment nodig is;
  • Je bent contactpersoon voor én tussen ouders/voogden, scholen en andere betrokken instanties.

“In deze uitdagende baan is geen dag hetzelfde. Je mag dichtbij de jongere komen in zijn of haar meest kwetsbare situatie”
Femke, jeugdzorgwerker C crisisopvang

Dit vragen we van je

  • Een relevant hbo-diploma (bijvoorbeeld Social Work of Pedagogiek);
  • Registratie in het beroepsregister SKJ (Stichting Kwaliteitskader Jeugd);
  • Minimaal twee jaar ervaring in de (jeugd)zorg;
  • Kennis van de behandelmethodes Verbindend Gezag en Competentiegericht werken.

Dit bieden wij

Op basis van een 36-urige werkweek kun je rekenen op:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris volgens de cao Jeugdzorg (schaal 8) vanaf € 2.946,27 tot € 4.375,20, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;
  • Een jaarcontract. Functioneer je goed? Dan zetten we dit contract om in een vast dienstverband;
  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding;
  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris;
  • Een eigen coach die jou helpt met je persoonlijke doelstellingen en ontwikkeling.

Binnen Timon krijg je een uitgebreid inwerktraject waarin we je koppelen aan een buddy. Daarnaast volg je diverse trainingen en opleidingen gericht op jouw functie zoals: Competentiegericht werken & Verbindend Gezag, Open & Alert en Vlaggensysteem.

Deze functie noemen we in ons functiehuis: jeugdzorgwerker C.

Vind je het werken bij de Crisisopvang interessant, maar werk je graag flexibel? Bekijk dan onze vacature voor flexmedewerker bij de Crisisopvang: Begeleider Crisisopvang Jeugdzorg – flexpool Zeist | Timon

Wij zijn Timon
Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jóu. Iedereen kan een beroep op ons doen, ongeacht achtergrond en levensovertuiging. Met ruim 750 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. Timon innoveert en groeit. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra.

Jij @ Timon?
Denk jij dat Timon de organisatie is die bij je past? Solliciteer dan op de vacature voor jeugdzorgwerker crisisopvang. Voor vragen over de procedure kun je contact opnemen met onze recruiter.

Voor indiensttreding is het screeningsbeleid van Timon van toepassing. Deze is altijd opvraagbaar en wordt toegelicht in het arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek.

GET TO KNOW US

With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.
THE OPPORTUNITY

The Senior Manager, Tax Accounting & Reporting is responsible for overseeing tax accounting, income tax provision, and tax reporting, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting of income taxes under US GAAP/IFRS. This role manages global tax accounting obligations and supports broader tax risk management. Additionally, the role provides guidance on transfer pricing compliance as part of overall tax reporting. The ideal candidate has a strong technical background in tax accounting financial reporting, and international tax principles.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Lead preparation and review of the global income tax provision in line with ASC 740 and IFRS.
  • Ensure accurate calculation and reporting of deferred tax assets/liabilities, valuation allowances, and uncertain tax positions.
  • Coordinate with external auditors and internal finance teams to support tax provisions audits and financial statement disclosures.
  • Monitor changes in tax accounting standards, managing impact on financial statements.
  • Ensure compliance with tax reporting requirements, including country-by-country reporting (CbCR) and other regulatory disclosures.
  • Support the tax team in monitoring intercompany transactions and ensuring compliance with accounting OECD guidelines.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Bachelor degree in Accounting, Tax, Finance, or a related field.
  • Tax experience, preferably in a Big 4 accounting firm or a multinational corporation.
  • Advanced level in Excel.
  • Strong knowledge of ASC 740, IFRS, US GAAP and internal tax compliance.
  • Proficiency in Tax Software (e.g OneSource) and ERP systems.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills with the ability to manage stakeholders across departments.

Our benefits include:

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge.

Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page !

And to get a glimpse of Life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

On Site | São Paulo

EBANX is the leading payment platform connecting global companies with customers from the fastest-growing digital markets in the world.

Since the beginning of our journey, we have had one mission: to provide global access for everyone. We believe that transforming challenges into opportunities and making the impossible part of the journey is crucial! That's precisely why we created a payment technology that builds bridges between people and businesses every day in 29 rising markets across the globe.

We call ourselves ebankers, we are global thinkers, we value diversity, we foster creativity and we work hard to connect businesses and people worldwide through payments. Let's make history together?

You will work in a team of experienced developers and be responsible for maintaining a platform that processes millions of transactional requests every day. We cultivate an engineering culture that values and promotes sustainable quality, continuous delivery, high availability, quick feedback and meritocracy.

As an EBANX developer you will be responsible for:

  • Writing and testing code in an incremental, agile and well-documented way;
  • Doing thorough code-reviews and help your teammates with complex designs and architectural decisions;
  • Testing and following your code to production continuously;
  • Developing new tools to help facilitate all of your team's work;
  • Interacting with colleagues from different departments like Product, Finance, Risk and Business Development;
  • Working on strategic projects for EBANX;
  • Evolving and deciding the future of our payments platform;
  • A system of high availability (+ 99.9%) and with high throughput (100+ TPS), written in PHP, and MySQL (yes, it is possible :smile:). Don't know PHP? No problems, the important thing is to master the basics!

What is indispensable for the job?

  • Proven experience designing, implementing and deploying software solutions to production; the stack is not relevant, we are ready to teach it to new teammates if necessary;
  • Interest in subjects such as data structures, concurrency, persistence and distributed systems;
  • Expertise in git or any other collaborative version control system;
  • A vision for software quality, evolution of systems, decomposition of problems and abstractions;
  • A great ability to learn new practices, technologies, programming languages and absorbing engineering culture;

What would we love to see?

  • Passion for software, you go to sleep and wake up thinking about how to make that part of the system more elegant or efficient;
  • Advanced English, we have customers from all around the world and it is commonplace for us to speak and write English when helping, supporting and writing specifications with them;
  • Software development expertise in any complementary area to our core business, such as: data warehouses, specialized development platforms, infrastructure automation, services provisioning, real-time systems, fault tolerant systems and mission critical systems;
  • Experience with deploying to and monitoring a cloud infrastructure especially AWS.
  • Experience with computer networks, latency, package loss, routing optimization, monitoring and problem solving;
  • Full knowledge of SQL and relational databases;
  • Test driven development: you don't even remember how to code without a very extensive test coverage; You often write the tests first and then the code.
  • Expertise in at least one functional or logic programming language -- besides SQL ;)
  • Comfortable with challenges of concurrency problems and has already worked in distributed and asynchronous systems;
  • Knowledge of data replication and conciliation;

What are we going to offer so you can do an amazing job?

  • Sustainable work pace: 40 hours a week of an accelerated but not frenetic rhythm - no marathons or sleepless nights; The focus is on working smarter.
  • The best tools money can buy so you can be productive in your work; (Macbook, Jetbrains licenses, Slack, Github, TravisCI, NewRelic, DataDog, ElasticSearch, Kibana, Tableau amongst others)
  • Deep and fast code reviews for any of your pull requests - You will also do a lot of them :)
  • Constant discussions about our practices and systems, everybody that wants to speak out is always heard and we are always open to new ideas, practices and tools;
  • You will be free to dedicate part of your time to improve our systems and implement quality features that make us more efficient or less error prone;
  • Frequent, fair and transparent performance evaluations - all developers are evaluated with the same system and have access to the same career development opportunities;

description:
Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical

Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering

4 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.
Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.
Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.
As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.
The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team
  • Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training
  • Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS
  • Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value
  • Collaborate with other teams in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Senior Environmental Scientist, Geologist, Engineer or Hydrogeologist

Location: Bethlehem, PA, US, 18018-5717

Langan provides expert land development engineering and environmental consulting services for major developers, renewable energy producers, energy companies, corporations, healthcare systems, colleges/universities, and large infrastructure programs throughout the U.S. and around the world. Our employees collaborate seamlessly among 40+ offices and gain valuable hands-on experience that fosters career growth.

Consistently ranked among the top ten “Best Firms to Work For” and Engineering News-Record’s top 50 firms worldwide, Langan attracts and retains the best talent in the industry. Employees thrive at Langan, a firm that fosters an inclusive and supportive work environment for all; prioritizes wellbeing, health, and safety; encourages volunteerism and philanthropy; offers workplace flexibility, along with carbon-neutral office spaces; and empowers individuals to contribute their skills and knowledge to make impactful contributions.

Job Summary

Langan is seeking a Senior Environmental Scientist, Geologist, Engineer or Hydrogeologist to join its collaborative team in Bethlehem, PA . This individual will serve a key function in assisting with the natural resource planning, assessment and permitting of land development and infrastructure projects, and leading specific assignments and tasks. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a diverse team of top-notch professionals in a variety of geographic areas and regulatory programs, and to collaborate and learn from our multi-disciplinary team of site/civil, geotechnical, survey, and landscape architect professionals on landmark land development projects.

Job Responsibilities

  • Prepare the natural resource planning, assessment and permitting documents for land development and infrastructure projects in close collaboration with Project Personnel;
  • Effectively use reports, maps, drawings, engineering plans, tests, and aerial photographs to assess the natural resource characteristics of project sites for natural resource assessment and permitting due diligence to plan and design projects;
  • Perform natural resource feasibility assessments for development projects;
  • Write and/or review draft due diligence reports, assessment and permit applications;
  • Prepare site assessments and related natural resource figures using GIS and AutoCAD software;
  • Assist with the planning and execution of field investigations by performing field tests, collecting samples, collecting and recording data, and performing routine calculations;
  • Collect soil, soil vapor, indoor and ambient air, sediment, surface water, and groundwater samples;
  • Review and interpret environmental, geological, and historical records to support environmental due diligence;
  • Prepare a variety of standard logs and field forms (such as drilling logs, field investigation dailies, and chain of custody logs);
  • Identify and implement solutions to both routine and more complex field problems and document them accurately, keeping project manager informed of problems encountered during work assignments;
  • Lead tasks associated with the preparation and modification of various engineering documents including reports, specifications, plans, cost estimates and designs for projects;
  • Interact in a professional manner with client and subcontractor representatives in close collaboration with supervisor;
  • Supervise or coordinate the work of staff engineers, interns and others who assist in specific assignments as needed;
  • Coordinate and perform field inspection services, as needed; and
  • Perform other duties as requested.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Ecology or Planning;
  • 3+ years of experience in natural resource assessment and permitting;
  • Familiarity with current local, state, and federal land use permitting;
  • Strong GIS and AutoCAD skills;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
  • Strong attention to detail with excellent analytical, multitasking, and judgment capabilities;
  • Ability to effectively work independently and in a team environment;
  • Ability to occasionally participate in field work and work during evenings and/or weekends, as needed by project schedule;
  • Occasional travel to project sites and/or client locations, as required; and
  • Possess reliable transportation for client meetings and job site visits and a valid driver’s license in good standing.

Langan is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. We believe that an inclusive workplace is essential for the well-being and success of our employees.

What you'll do

Viasat seeks an expert attorney to provide legal support for Viasat's business units via the in-house legal department in São Paulo, Brazil. This role will also involve collaboration with the business and legal teams from the United States, other Latin American countries, and Europe. We provide strategic support for satellite telecommunications operations. By joining our legal team, you will gain hands-on experience in satellite telecommunications law, regulatory compliance, and contract negotiations. You will have the opportunity to work on real cases involving spectrum allocation, international agreements, and industry regulations. You'll also engage with various customers, including regulatory agencies, external legal firms, and business units, gaining exposure to the complexities of the satellite industry.


The day-to-day
  • Provide advice to all levels of Viasat in the areas of telecommunications transactions, regulation, administrative and litigation matters, and communicate legal concepts in a way that non-lawyers can understand.

  • Contract Review & Drafting: Assisting in the preparation and review of complex contracts, partnership and service agreements, NDAs, and compliance documents.
  • Regulatory Compliance Support: Monitoring changes in laws and preparing summaries or reports for the legal team;
  • Risk Assessment: Identifying potential legal risks in business operations and helping develop mitigation strategies.

  • Meetings & Teamwork: Participating in meetings with commercial teams, engineers, specialists, and external legal counsels to support business objectives.

    • Corporate law (corporate formation, governance and maintenance)
    • Tax law (knowledge of tax planning and indirect taxes applicable to telecommunications services is a plus)

  • Microsoft Office Proficiency – Experience using Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

  • Strong Written and Verbal Communication – Ability to clearly articulate legal concepts and draft well-structured documents.
  • Proactive Approach – Ability to take initiative, handle multiple tasks, and ensure accuracy in legal documents.
  • Ability to work at least 3 days per week in person at the Viasat office in São Paulo during business hours.

What will help you on the job
  • An interest in innovation, technology, and regulatory issues, especially in the telecommunication's area.

title: Brazil Product Strategy Manager
description:
A little bit about us:

We are Belvo, an open finance API platform with the bold vision of democratizing access to financial services in Latin America. We enable any financial innovator to access and interpret financial data, as well as initiate payments from their end-users accounts. We’re turning the messy complexities of the Latin American financial ecosystem into a modern set of tools to access and interpret data and move money in a seamless and secure way.

We’re a highly-technical, passionate, and driven team. We are more than 90 people and our team currently represents 20 nationalities. We have offices in São Paulo and Mexico City – while a large portion of us work remotely.

We are tackling a very stimulating problem: connecting fintech innovators with legacy financial infrastructure. We strive to go beyond the limits of what is possible today and to do so in an elegant and developer-first way.

Since starting our adventure in May 2019, we have raised $71m from the leading VC investors globally.

You can read more about our companyhere and about our team and culturehere . Also, head to our blog for more news about what we’re building and how we work .

About the team:

  • We work in cross-functional, autonomous teams. We follow continuous delivery best practices executed on top of a modern technology stack.

  • Our products are built for developers, by developers. Technological excellence is at the heart of what we do.

  • We are pragmatic and customer-focused. We strive to find the right set of trade-offs in order to validate our hypothesis as early as possible, iterating on our products based on customer feedback.

  • We communicate transparently. We do weekly all-hands where we get together to discuss company performance and goals.

  • While we are global and remote-friendly, we also operate from our vibrant offices in CDMX and Sao Paulo. To accommodate the various time zone sin which we are based, we ensure we’re always synced up between 3 pm and 6 pm, CEST.

  • Also, we are backed by some of the leading investors in Silicon Valley and Latin America, including Founders Fund, Kaszek Ventures, and YCombinator.

Your opportunity:

As Open Banking becomes a reality in Brazil, Belvo needs to nail its entrance in the regulated Open Banking ecosystem. Your job is to guide the already started strategy of the company on how to leverage Open Banking regulation for the benefit of Belvo. As a Product Strategy Manager at Belvo, you will:

  • Conduct Market Research: Analyze market trends and identify opportunities for Belvo in Brazil.

  • Identify Open Finance Use Cases : Explore new adoption scenarios for Open Finance in both data and payments.

  • Establish Strategic Partnerships: Forge relationships with enterprises and financial institutions to expand Belvo's reach.

  • Participate in Sales Processes: identify prospects and be a strategic asset to explain in detail our solutions to the most complex prospects of the company

  • Understand Financial Institutions' Needs: Assess complex requirements of financial institutions to identify partnership opportunities.

  • Deepen Product Knowledge : Become an expert in Open Finance in Brazil, including current and upcoming products from the Central Bank.

  • Engage with Regulators and Ecosystem Players: Collaborate with regulators, financial institutions, and other stakeholders to advance the Open Finance ecosystem.

  • Create Informative Materials: Develop data-driven materials showcasing the status and areas for improvement in Open Finance.

  • Participate in Open Finance Groups: Join various Open Finance groups and coordinate internal participation to maximize value.

  • Monitor the Ecosystem: Continuously track the ecosystem, mapping new and existing players to understand market trends.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with product management, sales, customer success, and engineering stakeholders.

  • Navigate Open Finance Regulations: Possess a deep understanding of Open Finance regulations to coordinate discussions with legal, compliance, design, and product teams.

This position may be for you if:

  • 3+ years of experience working in the fintech industry

  • You are an expert in the regulated Open Finance ecosystem in Brazil

  • You are familiar with how Open Banking data and/or payments solutions can be can be used for credit risk analysis improvement

  • You are able to guide and execute complex research projects and manage the relationship with different stakeholders

  • You are well connected in the Open Banking space and you already know who can be good partners in our Open Banking initiative

  • You are reasoned, data driven, insightful and have experience solving complex problems in elegant and efficient ways

  • You are adaptable, enjoy fast-paced environments

  • Good spoken and written English

title: Intensief Ambulante Gezinsbehandelaar
description:
Werken bij Stichting JA! – Dichtbij, Outreachend en Betekenisvol

Bij Stichting JA! staan we midden tussen de inwoners van de wijk. We bieden aanvullende gespecialiseerde jeugdhulp in Amsterdam, Diemen, Uithoorn en Ouder-Amstel, zonder onnodige drempels. Onze aanpak? Outreachend, laagdrempelig en dichtbij, bij gezinnen thuis, op scholen en op alle plekken waar jeugdigen zich bevinden.

In onze multidisciplinaire gebiedsteams bundelen we de krachten met professionals uit verschillende organisaties. Zo zorgen we ervoor dat gezinnen snel en effectief de juiste ondersteuning krijgen. Geen hulpvraag is hetzelfde, en dát maakt ons werk dynamisch, uitdagend en ontzettend waardevol.

Waar kom je terecht?

Samen met psychologen, orthopedagogen, (transcultureel) systeemtherapeuten, jeugd- en gezinscoaches en IAG-ers werk je aan complexe hulpvragen. We kijken juist niet alleen naar problemen, maar vooral naar de kracht en veerkracht van elk gezin.

Waarom kiezen voor Stichting JA!?

  • Dichtbij en betrokken: Je bent aanwezig in de wijk en staat letterlijk naast gezinnen.
  • Systemisch werken: Alleen door systemisch te werken, komen we samen tot duurzame oplossingen.
  • Maatwerk : Geen standaardoplossingen, maar hulp die écht past.
  • Sterk netwerk: Samenwerken met specialisten uit verschillende disciplines.
  • Ruimte om te groeien : Je leert van de specialisten om je heen én krijgt de vrijheid om je te ontwikkelen in de richting die bij jou past

Wil jij bijdragen aan een veerkrachtige jeugd in Amsterdam en omstreken? Sluit je aan bij ons team!

Jouw rol als Intensief Ambulante Gezinsbehandelaar

Als Intensief Ambulant Gezinsbehandelaar bij Stichting JA! sta jij midden in de leefwereld van gezinnen. Je bent daar waar het écht nodig is: thuis bij gezinnen, op school of in de wijk.

Samen met het gezin breng je de situatie in kaart, stel je samen doelen op en help je hen bij het creëren van een stabiele, veilige basis. Met jouw ondersteuning krijgen gezinnen de handvatten om uiteindelijk weer zelfstandig verder te kunnen.

Je staat er uiteraard niet alleen voor. Binnen onze gebiedsteams werk je samen met specialisten uit verschillende disciplines, zodat je altijd kunt sparren en kunt samenwerken. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat gezinnen de ondersteuning krijgen die ze nodig hebben.

Waar kom je in dienst?

Iedereen die werkzaam is bij Stichting JA! is in dienst van een van onze moederorganisaties. Onze moederorganisaties zijn: FamilySupporters, Groei & Glunder, Timon, Terminal 18, Zigzag Kindzorg, Fibbe.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je bent een enthousiaste, positieve collega en je omarmt onze manier van werken;
  • Affiniteit met onze diverse én specialistische jeugd-GGZ doelgroep;
  • Je wordt enthousiast van outreachend werken, waarbij je midden tussen de gezinnen in de wijk staat.

  • Een SKJ-registratie;

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een gedreven, multidisciplinair team waar collegialiteit, overleg en van elkaar leren (casuïstiek, intervisie en werkbegeleiding) centraal staan.
  • Ruimte om zelf te blijven groeien als professional, door ervaring en door de opleidingsmogelijkheden die we bieden.
  • JA! organiseert vier keer per jaar inhoudelijke kennissessies met gastsprekers om de kwaliteit en inhoud van ons werk verder te versterken.
  • Een team waarin iedereen zich welkom en gezien voelt, ongeacht culturele achtergrond, religie of levensstijl.
  • De ruimte om jouw werkweek in te vullen op een manier die voor jou werkt;

Enthousiast geraakt?

description:
St. Luke’s is proud of the skills, experience and compassion of its employees. The employees of St. Luke’s are our most valuable asset! Individually and together, our employees are dedicated to satisfying the mission of our organization which is an unwavering commitment to excellence as we care for the sick and injured; educate physicians, nurses and other health care providers; and improve access to care in the communities we serve, regardless of a patient’s ability to pay for health care.

The Psychologist provides counseling and psychological assessment and testing within an outpatient program. Performs assessment, testing for individual, family and group counseling. Coordinates and implements the treatment plan. Provides crisis intervention as necessary. Services are provided to adults, adolescents, children, families, and couples using knowledge and skills necessary to provide care appropriate to the age of the patients. In concert with psychiatrists, maintains a team approach in treating patients. Adheres to professional and ethical guidelines as outlined by mental health care organizations and associations.

DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW:

Gratifying to work with different patient populations.
Opportunity for further didactics and other educational opportunities.
Opportunity to be part of a growing department/service line.
Harmonious, team-oriented working environment.

WORKING SCHEDULE:

Typical working schedule Monday-Friday 7:30a – 4p.
No call, weekends or holidays.
Opportunity to work virtually one day per week.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Demonstrates competency in the assessment, range of treatment, knowledge of growth and development and communication appropriate to the age of the patient treated.
  2. Conducting scientific studies of behavior patterns and cognitive function.
  3. Observing and interviewing individuals, recording the interactions.
  4. Researching psychological, emotional, behavioral or organizational patterns and identifying issues.
  5. Diagnosing potential disorders.
  6. Discussing possible methods of treatment with patients.
  7. Researching and writing papers on clinical psychology issues and disorders.
  8. Performs appropriate treatment services to assigned clients. Uses interventions with assigned clients which meet accepted standards of mental health care and reflect consideration of treatment plan. Provides crisis management for assigned cases and is able to provide back up for the program.
  9. Maintains amount of weekly scheduled client hours as required by departmental needs and standards.
  10. Participates as a treatment team member and maintains a current level of psychological theory and practice. Attends clinical supervision meetings and staff meetings as scheduled and comes to meetings prepared. Keeps current with professional literature and trends in mental health. Attends continuing education trainings, workshops, seminars or conferences in order to keep current with evidenced based standards of practice and maintain licensure.
  11. Maintains active communication with identified staff and agencies that share case involvement when appropriate releases are signed.
  12. Maintains appropriate records of service rendered to or on behalf of the client populations served. Maintains clinical records of all client contacts according to QA & I, State and Joint Commission guidelines. Produces an evaluation report which effectively addresses the reason for referral and reflects the sound organization and synthesis of fact, impressions and clinical recommendations. Completes progress notes, reports and correspondence in a timely manner.
  13. Exercises appropriate self-management in the performance of all duties.
  14. Completes client satisfaction tools as required by departmental standards.
  15. Performs thorough Risk Assessment at intake session and as needed thereafter.
  16. Supports community and/or network departments and service lines by speaking at support groups, teaching about mental wellness related topics, providing stress management seminars and like duties as assigned.
  17. Provides Psychological services (psychotherapy via video, tele-therapy through hospital vetted format) as assigned.

EDUCATION/TRAINING REQUIREMENTS:

Must have a Clinical PsyD or PHD in clinical Psychology or related area.
Prefer graduate from a Neuropsychological curriculum.
Prefer rehab psychology or Neuropsychology internship and 2 year post doc.
Clinical training shall include diagnostic skills and clinical interventions which meet accepted and current standards of care.
Must be knowledgeable in Neuropsychological Assessment and Psychological related to Psychiatric Diagnosis assessments.
Outpatient evaluations, Neuropsychological Testing, Report Writing & Interpretation, Feedback, Therapy.
Must be able to perform pre-surgical epilepsy evaluations and potentially Wada’s.

PHYSICAL AND SENSORY REQUIREMENTS:

Able to communicate effectively (both verbally and in writing). Positive interpersonal skills required. Sits stands and walks for extended periods of time. Requires some light lifting. Potential for participation in therapeutic recreational activities.
Sit up to 8 hours per day; 3 hours at a time. Stand for up to 8 hours per day; 8 hours at a time. Walking for up to 6 hours per day. Frequently lifting, carrying and pushing objects up to 10 pounds. Rarely lifting, carrying and pushing objects up to 75 pounds. Frequently stooping and bending. Frequently reaching above shoulder level. Frequently handling, firm grasping and twisting & turning as it relates to performing procedures. Must be able to perceive attributes of an object through touch. Must be able to hear as it relates to normal conversation, high and low frequencies. Must be able to see as it relates to general, near, far, color and peripheral vision. Must be able to speak as it relates to normal conversation and projection as it relates to lectures and presentations.

title: Technical Project Manager - Telco / MVNO Integration
description:
Technical Project Manager - Telco / MVNO Integration

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in nine countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 400 experts across 13 countries.

Position Overview

This is a key role in the Network Engineering and delivery team, responsible for managing the end-to-end delivery of a range of projects including complex systems integrations across telecoms networks and IT systems in multiple geographical locations and technical environments. This will require working with both internal and external teams to understand business strategy, business requirements and the delivery of solutions according to business priorities and to time, cost and quality. This role is based in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with project teams (including vendors) and programme managers to define & agree scope and deliver the design, build and transformation of aggressive parallel deliveries across telecoms networks and IT systems, covering all features of the project both business and technology related.
  • Be business' representative and act on their authority and behalf to ensure delivery of appropriate business outcomes.
  • Work across the business to ensure the right level of engagement from project teams and stakeholders to ensure alignment across all teams driving towards continuous integration rather than delivering individual work streams in parallel.
  • Manage regular and consistent project planning sessions, meetings, and retrospectives, ensuring adherence to existing Project management processes and controls.
  • Pro-actively manage risks, issues corrections and escalations to ensure delivery remains on track to time, cost and quality.
  • Ensure that all project dependencies are identified, communicated and proactively managed.
  • Manage project expenditure and value, ensuring focus on business benefit realisation.

Requirements

Must Have

  • Minimum of 5-8 years' experience in project management role experience, covering the end-to-end project life cycle, ideally with a Telecoms, IT service or consulting company.
  • A background in mobile telecoms or the wider Telco industry sector is essential.
  • Previous experience in large telecom projects in Mobile Network Operators or Mobile Virtual Network Operators.
  • A track record in the delivery of Telecom integration projects, with high complexity, with multiple third-party suppliers.
  • Strong vendor and stakeholder relationship skills.
  • Managing complex resources and multiple teams in a matrix structure.
  • Management and delivery of concurrent projects that vary in scale and complexity.
  • Driven, energetic, robust and able to work independently without supervision.
  • Must be proactive, hands-on and be able to work independently.
  • Commercially oriented and able to manage relationships at a senior level.
  • Demonstrable experience in project management methodologies.
  • English and Portuguese proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus.
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in Mobile networks delivery projects, from the service provider or vendor side.
  • Previous experience with Telecom regulatory framework including, but not limited to, lawful interception.

Benefits

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 40% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Mid-Senior level
